description:
List outdated packages and manage upgrades from the top bar, for all package managers at once: apt, dnf, pacman, zypper, flatpak, snap, brew, pip, npm, cargo, gem and dozens more.

This extension is a frontend to the mpm CLI, which must be installed separately: https://kdeldycke.github.io/meta-package-manager/install.html
name: Meta Package Manager
